{{short description|German mathematical physicist}}
[[File:Katrin Wendland.jpg|thumb|Wendland in 2010]]
'''Katrin Wendland''' (born 1970)<ref>Birth year from [https://books.google.com/books?id=6zYpBAAAQBAJ&pg=PA461 author information] for her edited volume with [[Annette Werner]], ''Facettenreiche Mathematik: Einblicke in die moderne mathematische Forschung für alle, die mehr von Mathematik verstehen wollen'' (Springer, 2011), p. 461.</ref> is a German [[mathematical physics|mathematical physicist]] who works as a professor at [[Trinity College Dublin]].<ref name="cv">{{cite web|title=Curriculum Vitae |url=https://www.maths.tcd.ie/~wendland/cv.html |website=www.maths.tcd.ie |publisher=School of Mathematics |accessdate=27 May 2023}}.</ref>

Wendland earned a diploma in mathematics from the [[University of Bonn]] in 1996, and a PhD in physics from the University of Bonn in 2000, under the supervision of [[Werner Nahm]]. After being a lecturer and then senior lecturer at the [[University of Warwick]] from 2002 to 2006, she returned to Germany as a professor at the [[University of Augsburg]], where she held the Chair for Analysis and Geometry. She moved to [[University of Freiburg|Albert-Ludwigs-Universität Freiburg]] in 2011 and then to Trinity College Dublin in 2022.<ref name="cv"/>

In 2009, Wendland was given the Medal for special merits for Bavaria in a united Europe by the Bavarian government.<ref name="cv"/> In 2010 she was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]], with a talk entitled "On the geometry of singularities in quantum field theories". In 2012 she became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2014-12-24.</ref> She was elected to the [[Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur]] in 2013.<ref name="cv"/> In 2023 she was elected a fellow of Trinity College Dublin.<ref>{{cite web|title=Trinity Monday 2023 - Fellows and Scholars |url=https://www.tcd.ie/Secretary/FellowsScholars/fellowship/ |website=www.tcd.ie |publisher=Trinity College Dublin |date=25 April 2023 |accessdate=27 May 2023}}</ref>
